message.reasoning:
We are going to add a "Report broken link" button to the 404 page that opens a pre-filled GitHub issue.
 We already have a copyCurrentUrl function in app.js that copies the current URL. We can adapt that to open a GitHub issue.
 However, note that the existing copyCurrentUrl function is already used by the copy URL button in 404.html.
 We want to add a new button that opens a GitHub issue with the current URL pre-filled in the title and/or body.

 Steps:
 1. In site/app.js, add a new function `reportBrokenLink()` that:
    - Constructs a GitHub issue URL for the repository (https://github.com/s04/momento/issues/new)
    - With parameters: title and body that include the current URL and a note that it's a broken link report.
    - Then opens that URL in a new tab (or window).

 2. In site/404.html, add a new button for reporting the broken link, placed alongside the existing Print and Copy URL buttons.

 3. Update MEMORY.md with a note about this change.

 Files to change:
   - site/app.js: add the reportBrokenLink function and attach it to the button (if we are using event listener in the init block).
   - site/404.html: add the button and its associated message and region elements (if we want to use the same copy feedback pattern? Actually, for reporting we don't need to copy, we just open an issue. So we don't need the message and region for copy feedback. But we can keep the button simple.)

 However, note that the existing copy buttons in 404.html are:
   - Print button: id="print-page-btn"
   - Copy URL button: id="copy-url-btn"

 We'll add a third button: id="report-link-btn"

 We don't need a message and region for this button because we are not copying to clipboard.

 But to keep the structure similar, we can optionally add a message region for feedback (e.g., "Issue opened!") but it's not required.
 Let's keep it simple: just the button that opens the issue.

 We'll add the event listener in the init block of app.js.

 Risk: 
   - We are only touching site/app.js and site/404.html, and MEMORY.md.
   - The change is small and follows existing patterns.

 Let's draft the changes:

 In site/app.js, add the function:

   function reportBrokenLink() {
     const repo = 's04/momento';
     const url = encodeURIComponent(window.location.href);
     const title = encodeURIComponent('Broken link report: ' + window.location.href);
     const body = encodeURIComponent('I encountered a broken link on the Momento site.\n\nURL: ' + window.location.href + '\n\nPlease check this link and fix if necessary.');
     const issueUrl = `https://github.com/${repo}/issues/new?title=${title}&body=${body}`;
     window.open(issueUrl, '_blank');
   }

 Then, in the init block (if isClient), we add:
   id('report-link-btn')?.addEventListener('click', reportBrokenLink);

 In site/404.html, we add the button in the same section as the other buttons:

   <section class="panel">
     <button id="print-page-btn" class="copy-btn" aria-label="Print this page">🖨️ Print</button>
     <button id="copy-url-btn" class="copy-btn" aria-label="Copy this page URL">🔗 Copy URL</button>
     <button id="report-link-btn" class="copy-btn" aria-label="Report this broken link">🐞 Report link</button>
   </section>

 We choose the bug icon (🐞) for reporting.

 We are only to name the files and any risk.

 So, for now, we just state:

   Files to rewrite: site/app.js, site/404.html, MEMORY.md
   Risk: Low - the changes are isolated and follow existing patterns.
